2609.40219.title: Learning Skills from Historical Action Trajectories: Action Experience Dictionary for World Action Models
2609.40219.paper_summary: World Action Models (WAMs) couple visual dynamics prediction with action generation, yet they do not explicitly support the reuse of action experience across manipulation tasks. Furthermore, existing WAMs struggle to capture underlying cross-task semantic relationships that could guide target action prediction, as redundant background elements interfere with the extraction of key visual information. To address these challenges, we develop a novel Action Experience Dictionary (AED) that encodes historical physical action trajectories into shared action embeddings to support skill reuse and model cross-task relationships. Specifically, we first aggregate historical actions to align with visual observations and retrieve action embeddings from the AED using a pretrained action tokenizer. Subsequently, we visually condition the pooled embeddings through cross-attention and prepend them to noisy action tokens, providing interaction context and action intent for prediction. To model action-related motion and reduce reliance on irrelevant background cues, we introduce a motion-aware transition loss that supervises visual feature change prediction over random temporal intervals. Experiments on simulation benchmarks and in real-world cross-embodiment settings verify the effectiveness of our AED. The anonymous project website is available at \href{https://github.com/JiahuaDong/AED}{AED}.
2609.40219.paper_summary_zh: 世界行動模型（WAMs）將視覺動態預測與行動生成結合在一起，但它們並未明確支持在操作任務中重用行動經驗。 此外，現有的 WAMs 在捕捉潛在的跨任務語義關係方面存在困難，這些關係可以指導目標行動預測，因為冗餘的背景元素干擾了關鍵視覺信息的提取。 為了解決這些挑戰，我們開發了一種新穎的行動經驗字典（AED），該字典將歷史物理行動軌跡編碼為共享的行動嵌入，以支持技能重用和模型跨任務關係。 具體而言，我們首先聚合歷史行動以對齊視覺觀察，並使用預訓練的行動標記器從 AED 中檢索行動嵌入。 隨後，我們通過跨注意力視覺條件化聚合的嵌入，並將其添加到嘈雜的行動標記中，為預測提供互動上下文和行動意圖。 為了建模與行動相關的運動並減少對無關背景線索的依賴，我們引入了一種運動感知過渡損失，該損失監督隨機時間間隔內的視覺特徵變化預測。 在模擬基準和現實世界跨體現設置中的實驗驗證了我們的 AED 的有效性。 匿名項目網站可在 \href{https://github.com/JiahuaDong/AED}{AED} 獲得。
